planets.name: KELT-23 A b
planets.description: Transiting planet of KELT-23 A with a 2.26-day year, found in 2019.

text.card: KELT-23 A b was found in 2019 by KELT-North as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around KELT-23 A. Its orbit and size follow Johns et al. 2019's fit, the archive's default.
